chunks: Ahmad ibn Idrees, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu Jareer al-Qummi, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام: “May I be sacrificed for you, you have known my devotion to your father, then to you. Then I swore to him, by the right of Rasool Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the right of so-and-so and so-and-so, until I ended with him, that whatever you inform me of will not go out from me to anyone among the people.”

And I asked him about his father: “Is he alive or dead?” So he said: “By Allah, he has died.” I said: “May I be sacrificed for you, your Shi'a narrate that in him is the sunnah of four Prophets.” He said: “By Allah, other than Whom there is no god, he has perished.” I said: “A perishing of occultation or a perishing of death?” He said: “A perishing of death.”

So I said: “Perhaps you are practicing taqiyyah with me.” He said: “Glory be to Allah.” I said: “Did he appoint you by وصية?” He said: “Yes.” I said: “Did he include anyone with you in it?” He said: “No.” I said: “Is there an Imam over you from among your brothers?” He said: “No.” I said: “So you are the Imam?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he bequeathed or designated through وصية
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the divinely designated religious authority and leader
key_terms.انْقِطَاعِي: my exclusive devotion and turning away from others toward the Imam
key_terms.تَقِيَّةٍ: dissimulation for protection under sensitive circumstances
key_terms.سُنَّةَ: a characteristic pattern or precedent attributed here to Prophets
key_terms.غَيْبَةٍ: occultation or absence from public view
key_terms.هَلَاكَ: passing away or perishing, clarified in the report as actual death

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith establish the death of the previous Imam and the designation of the next Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith records Abu Jareer al-Qummi’s direct questioning of Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام regarding the death of his father and the transfer of the Imamate. The Imam عليه السلام explicitly affirms that his father died an actual death, not a ghaybah, and confirms that the وصية came specifically to him, establishing his singular status as Imam.
